current_owl:
@prefix rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#> .
@prefix rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#> .
@prefix xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#> .
@prefix owl: <http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#> .
@prefix : <http://www.example.org/ontology#> .

:EDIFACTInvoiceOntology rdf:type owl:Ontology ;
    rdfs:label "EDIFACT Invoice Ontology" ;
    rdfs:comment "A deep OWL ontology for EDIFACT invoice messages, D96A/EANCOM/EN16931-1, and P2P-O requirements." .

### Classes
:InterchangeEnvelope rdf:type owl:Class ; rdfs:label "Interchange Envelope" ; rdfs:comment "The envelope containing EDIFACT messages." .
:Message rdf:type owl:Class ; rdfs:label "Message" ; rdfs:comment "A generic EDIFACT message." .
:InvoiceMessage rdf:type owl:Class ; rdfs:label "Invoice Message" ; rdfs:comment "An invoice message (INVOIC) within an Interchange Envelope." ; rdfs:subClassOf :Message .
:Segment rdf:type owl:Class ; rdfs:label "Segment" ; rdfs:comment "A segment in an EDIFACT message." .
:BGM_Segment rdf:type owl:Class ; rdfs:label "BGM Segment" ; rdfs:comment "Beginning of Message segment for document identification." ; rdfs:subClassOf :Segment .
:NAD_Segment rdf:type owl:Class ; rdfs:label "NAD Segment" ; rdfs:comment "Name and Address segment for participant details." ; rdfs:subClassOf :Segment .
:CompositeDataElement rdf:type owl:Class ; rdfs:label "Composite Data Element" ; rdfs:comment "Composite data element within a segment." ; rdfs:subClassOf :Segment .
:SimpleDataElement rdf:type owl:Class ; rdfs:label "Simple Data Element" ; rdfs:comment "Simple data element within a composite element." ; rdfs:subClassOf :CompositeDataElement .
:HeaderSection rdf:type owl:Class ; rdfs:label "Header Section" ; rdfs:comment "Header section of an invoice message." ; rdfs:subClassOf :Segment .
:DetailSection rdf:type owl:Class ; rdfs:label "Detail Section" ; rdfs:comment "Detail section listing invoice line items." ; rdfs:subClassOf :Segment .
:SummarySection rdf:type owl:Class ; rdfs:label "Summary Section" ; rdfs:comment "Summary section providing totals." ; rdfs:subClassOf :Segment .
:Organization rdf:type owl:Class ; rdfs:label "Organization" ; rdfs:comment "An organization involved in the invoice." .
:AgentRole rdf:type owl:Class ; rdfs:label "Agent Role" ; rdfs:comment "A role played by an organization." .
:BuyerRole rdf:type owl:Class ; rdfs:label "Buyer Role" ; rdfs:comment "The buyer role in the invoice." ; rdfs:subClassOf :AgentRole .
:DeliveryPartyRole rdf:type owl:Class ; rdfs:label "Delivery Party Role" ; rdfs:comment "The delivery party role in the invoice." ; rdfs:subClassOf :AgentRole .
:Address rdf:type owl:Class ; rdfs:label "Address" ; rdfs:comment "Address of an organization." .
:GlobalLocationNumber rdf:type owl:Class ; rdfs:label "Global Location Number" ; rdfs:comment "GLN identifier for an organization." .
:Item rdf:type owl:Class ; rdfs:label "Item" ; rdfs:comment "An item sold in the invoice." .
:Price rdf:type owl:Class ; rdfs:label "Price" ; rdfs:comment "Net price of an item." .
:Quantity rdf:type owl:Class ; rdfs:label "Quantity" ; rdfs:comment "Quantity of an item." .
:InvoiceAmount rdf:type owl:Class ; rdfs:label "Invoice Amount" ; rdfs:comment "Total invoice amount." .
:InvoiceNumber rdf:type owl:Class ; rdfs:label "Invoice Number" ; rdfs:comment "Invoice number." .
:BusinessProcess rdf:type owl:Class ; rdfs:label "Business Process" ; rdfs:comment "Business process to which the invoice is assigned." .
:ReferenceNumber rdf:type owl:Class ; rdfs:label "Reference Number" ; rdfs:comment "Reference number in the header section." .
:DocumentDate rdf:type owl:Class ; rdfs:label "Document Date" ; rdfs:comment "Date of the document." .
:TaxAmount rdf:type owl:Class ; rdfs:label "Tax Amount" ; rdfs:comment "Total tax amount in the summary section." .
:ValidationConstraint rdf:type owl:Class ; rdfs:label "Validation Constraint" ; rdfs:comment "Constraint for automated validation (e.g., SHACL)." .
:Identifier rdf:type owl:Class ; rdfs:label "Identifier" ; rdfs:comment "Generic identifier required by D96A." .
:OrganizationRoleAssignment rdf:type owl:Class ; rdfs:label "Organization Role Assignment" ; rdfs:comment "Pivot class for linking organizations to roles in a message." .
:InvoiceLineItem rdf:type owl:Class ; rdfs:label "Invoice Line Item" ; rdfs:comment "Pivot class for item, price, and quantity in a detail section." .

### Disjointness
:BuyerRole owl:disjointWith :DeliveryPartyRole .
:HeaderSection owl:disjointWith :DetailSection .
:DetailSection owl:disjointWith :SummarySection .
:SummarySection owl:disjointWith :HeaderSection .

### Object Properties
:containsMessage rdf:type owl:ObjectProperty ; rdfs:label "contains message" ; rdfs:comment "Interchange envelope contains messages." ; rdfs:domain :InterchangeEnvelope ; rdfs:range :Message ; owl:TransitiveProperty true .
:hasSegment rdf:type owl:ObjectProperty ; rdfs:label "has segment" ; rdfs:comment "Message has segments." ; rdfs:domain :Message ; rdfs:range :Segment .
:hasSection rdf:type owl:ObjectProperty ; rdfs:label "has section" ; rdfs:comment "Message has header, detail, and summary sections." ; rdfs:domain :Message ; rdfs:range _:SectionUnion .
:hasCompositeElement rdf:type owl:ObjectProperty ; rdfs:label "has composite element" ; rdfs:comment "Segment has composite data elements." ; rdfs:domain :Segment ; rdfs:range :CompositeDataElement .
:hasSimpleElement rdf:type owl:ObjectProperty ; rdfs:label "has simple element" ; rdfs:comment "Composite data element has simple data elements." ; rdfs:domain :CompositeDataElement ; rdfs:range :SimpleDataElement .
:hasOrganizationRoleAssignment rdf:type owl:ObjectProperty ; rdfs:label "has organization role assignment" ; rdfs:comment "Invoice message has organization role assignments." ; rdfs:domain :InvoiceMessage ; rdfs:range :OrganizationRoleAssignment .
:assignedRole rdf:type owl:ObjectProperty ; rdfs:label "assigned role" ; rdfs:comment "Role assigned in organization role assignment." ; rdfs:domain :OrganizationRoleAssignment ; rdfs:range :AgentRole ; owl:FunctionalProperty true .
:assignedOrganization rdf:type owl:ObjectProperty ; rdfs:label "assigned organization" ; rdfs:comment "Organization assigned in organization role assignment." ; rdfs:domain :OrganizationRoleAssignment ; rdfs:range :Organization ; owl:FunctionalProperty true .
:hasAddress rdf:type owl:ObjectProperty ; rdfs:label "has address" ; rdfs:comment "Organization has address." ; rdfs:domain :Organization ; rdfs:range :Address .
:hasGlobalLocationNumber rdf:type owl:ObjectProperty ; rdfs:label "has global location number" ; rdfs:comment "Organization has GLN." ; rdfs:domain :Organization ; rdfs:range :GlobalLocationNumber ; owl:FunctionalProperty true .
:hasLineItem rdf:type owl:ObjectProperty ; rdfs:label "has line item" ; rdfs:comment "Invoice message has line items." ; rdfs:domain :InvoiceMessage ; rdfs:range :InvoiceLineItem .
:soldItem rdf:type owl:ObjectProperty ; rdfs:label "sold item" ; rdfs:comment "Invoice line item refers to sold item." ; rdfs:domain :InvoiceLineItem ; rdfs:range :Item ; owl:FunctionalProperty true .
:hasPrice rdf:type owl:ObjectProperty ; rdfs:label "has price" ; rdfs:comment "Invoice line item has price." ; rdfs:domain :InvoiceLineItem ; rdfs:range :Price ; owl:FunctionalProperty true .
:hasQuantity rdf:type owl:ObjectProperty ; rdfs:label "has quantity" ; rdfs:comment "Invoice line item has quantity." ; rdfs:domain :InvoiceLineItem ; rdfs:range :Quantity ; owl:FunctionalProperty true .
:hasInvoiceAmount rdf:type owl:ObjectProperty ; rdfs:label "has invoice amount" ; rdfs:comment "Invoice message has invoice amount." ; rdfs:domain :InvoiceMessage ; rdfs:range :InvoiceAmount ; owl:FunctionalProperty true .
:hasInvoiceNumber rdf:type owl:ObjectProperty ; rdfs:label "has invoice number" ; rdfs:comment "Invoice message has invoice number." ; rdfs:domain :InvoiceMessage ; rdfs:range :InvoiceNumber ; owl:FunctionalProperty true .
:assignedToBusinessProcess rdf:type owl:ObjectProperty ; rdfs:label "assigned to business process" ; rdfs:comment "Invoice message assigned to a business process." ; rdfs:domain :InvoiceMessage ; rdfs:range :BusinessProcess ; owl:FunctionalProperty true .

### Data Properties
:referenceNumber rdf:type owl:DatatypeProperty ; rdfs:label "reference number" ; rdfs:comment "Reference number in header section." ; rdfs:domain :HeaderSection ; rdfs:range xsd:string ; owl:FunctionalProperty true .
:documentDate rdf:type owl:DatatypeProperty ; rdfs:label "document date" ; rdfs:comment "Date in header section." ; rdfs:domain :HeaderSection ; rdfs:range xsd:string ; owl:FunctionalProperty true .
:addressLine rdf:type owl:DatatypeProperty ; rdfs:label "address line" ; rdfs:comment "Address line of an address." ; rdfs:domain :Address ; rdfs:range xsd:string .
:postalCode rdf:type owl:DatatypeProperty ; rdfs:label "postal code" ; rdfs:comment "Postal code of an address." ; rdfs:domain :Address ; rdfs:range xsd:string .
:city rdf:type owl:DatatypeProperty ; rdfs:label "city" ; rdfs:comment "City of an address." ; rdfs:domain :Address ; rdfs:range xsd:string .
:countryCode rdf:type owl:DatatypeProperty ; rdfs:label "country code" ; rdfs:comment "Country code of an address." ; rdfs:domain :Address ; rdfs:range xsd:string .
:globalLocationNumberValue rdf:type owl:DatatypeProperty ; rdfs:label "GLN value" ; rdfs:comment "Value of a global location number." ; rdfs:domain :GlobalLocationNumber ; rdfs:range xsd:string ; owl:FunctionalProperty true .
:itemName rdf:type owl:DatatypeProperty ; rdfs:label "item name" ; rdfs:comment "Name of an item." ; rdfs:domain :Item ; rdfs:range xsd:string ; owl:FunctionalProperty true .
:netPrice rdf:type owl:DatatypeProperty ; rdfs:label "net price" ; rdfs:comment "Net price of an item." ; rdfs:domain :Price ; rdfs:range xsd:decimal ; owl:FunctionalProperty true .
:quantityValue rdf:type owl:DatatypeProperty ; rdfs:label "quantity value" ; rdfs:comment "Quantity value of an item." ; rdfs:domain :Quantity ; rdfs:range xsd:decimal ; owl:FunctionalProperty true .
:invoiceAmountValue rdf:type owl:DatatypeProperty ; rdfs:label "invoice amount value" ; rdfs:comment "Value of invoice amount." ; rdfs:domain :InvoiceAmount ; rdfs:range xsd:decimal ; owl:FunctionalProperty true .
:invoiceNumberValue rdf:type owl:DatatypeProperty ; rdfs:label "invoice number value" ; rdfs:comment "Value of invoice number." ; rdfs:domain :InvoiceNumber ; rdfs:range xsd:string ; owl:FunctionalProperty true .
:taxAmountValue rdf:type owl:DatatypeProperty ; rdfs:label "tax amount value" ; rdfs:comment "Value of tax amount." ; rdfs:domain :TaxAmount ; rdfs:range xsd:decimal ; owl:FunctionalProperty true .

### Restrictions & Equivalences
:InvoiceMessage owl:equivalentClass [ rdf:type owl:Class ; owl:onProperty :hasInvoiceNumber ; owl:allValuesFrom :InvoiceNumber ] .
:InvoiceLineItem owl:equivalentClass [ rdf:type owl:Class ; owl:onProperty :soldItem ; owl:allValuesFrom :Item ; owl:onProperty :hasPrice ; owl:allValuesFrom :Price ; owl:onProperty :hasQuantity ; owl:allValuesFrom :Quantity ] .

_:SectionUnion rdf:type owl:Class ; owl:disjointUnionOf ( :HeaderSection :DetailSection :SummarySection ) .

HIGH PRIORITY:
- CQ5: Organization class lacks explicit listing of all organizational attributes. Only address and GLN are modeled. Missing contact details, legal identifiers (e.g., VAT number, company register ID), and additional info (email, phone, etc.). Plan: Add new data properties to Organization for contact info (email, phone), legal identifiers (VAT, company register), and enrich with optional attributes (website, legal name, etc.).
- CQ13: ValidationConstraint class exists but lacks explicit SHACL property structure or mandatory field modeling. Directory requirements (D96A, EN16931-1) are not fully formalized. Plan: Add SHACL-like properties (e.g., sh:property, sh:path, sh:minCount, sh:maxCount, sh:datatype) to ValidationConstraint; connect to core classes. Add mandatory field restrictions (owl:minCardinality, owl:allValuesFrom) for required properties.

MEDIUM PRIORITY:
- GCAs: Add General Class Axioms, e.g., Buyer = Organization with BuyerRole in InvoiceMessage. Plan: Define GCA for Buyer as equivalent to OrganizationRoleAssignment with assignedRole BuyerRole and assignedOrganization Organization.
- SectionUnion: Replace _:SectionUnion blank node with named class :SectionUnion for tool compatibility. Plan: Create :SectionUnion as named class and use owl:disjointUnionOf.

- Advanced property characteristics: Add inverse properties (e.g., isSegmentOf), cardinality restrictions (min/max for mandatory fields), and symmetric/transitive/inverse properties where relevant.

Constraint Adherence:
